**Risk flags:**

- Only 1 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview:**  
Sinar Gemilang Associates Sdn. Bhd. provides management consulting services for small‑and‑medium enterprises (PKS) and is incorporated in Kuala Lumpur on 23 December 2023 as a private limited company. The firm has a share capital of RM 500,000, five directors, and a dominant shareholder owning 72.94% of the equity. Reported revenue for the available year is RM 27,799,367 with equity of RM 30,508,762; net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not disclosed. No legal cases are recorded against the company.
